bible.text: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why does everyone else already know exactly what they're doing with their life? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I don't even know what I want to study, let alone what I'm supposed to be 'called' to do.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Did I ask you to see the whole staircase, or just take the next step?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if I take the wrong step and waste years figuring out nothing?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A season spent searching isn't wasted. I use it to shape what you can't see yet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone keeps asking me what my plan is. I don't have one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't need a five-year plan. You need to walk with Me, one day at a time.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So it's okay that I still don't know who I am yet?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not lost. You're becoming. And I'm not finished with you.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not behind, child. You're exactly where I'm walking with you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: 🙏 Type "Amen" if you're trusting Him with what's next.
